name: sigcraft
idea: SigCraft is a free, browser-based email signature generator that lets professionals build polished, HTML-ready email signatures in seconds with live preview, multiple themes, and layout options — no account or backend required.
why_trending: Email signature generators appear on every major micro-SaaS trend list for 2026; 'email signature generator' commands 100K+ monthly searches and is consistently featured on Product Hunt, indie hacker forums, and micro-SaaS idea aggregators as a proven, high-traffic niche.
why_profitable: Competitors like Wisestamp ($6-12/month), HubSpot Email Signature Generator (free tier drives massive ad revenue), and Exclaimer ($1-3/user/month) demonstrate strong willingness to pay; monetization via freemium (advanced templates/branding removal), one-time purchase for premium theme packs, or display ads on the free tier.
why_easy: The entire product is a single HTML file: a form updates an in-page state object, a render function builds a table-based HTML signature string, and the result is displayed live in an email mockup. No server, no database, no build step — just pure HTML/CSS/JS with clipboard API for copy functionality.
note: Dedicated repo pepegoat/sigcraft to be created manually — session scope restricted to pepegoat/idea-queue. Full working demo (1041 lines) committed to demos/sigcraft/index.html in this repo.
